name: puppet
title: world.puppet
lead: Places a mob's body with no mind of its own that the script moves; its name tag always shows. An error when this game has no such mob kind.
signature: world.puppet(opts: { kind: string, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: BodyRotation ?, name: Text ? }) → Puppet

params.name: opts
params.type: { kind: string , at: Vec3 ?, rotation: BodyRotation ?, name: Text ? }

usedIn.quote: | A mob appearance moved entirely by the pack | `world.puppet` | Uses a mob body without its AI or gameplay simulation. |
local p = world.puppet{ kind = "horse", at = vec3(0.5, 65, -100.5), rotation = { yaw = 90 }, name = { "Lightning", color = "gold" } }   -- name is text
